organization_definition: A collective Agent with a common purpose beyond its current members that can act collectively.
excluded_denotations: country names used only as places
projects that do not denote collective Agents
initiatives that do not denote collective Agents
boundary_rules: Use the maximal literal expression for one displayed name.

Classify the entity denoted rather than classifying from a word in its name; a named project is an Organization when its known referent is a collective Agent such as a cross-functional team or joint venture.
Treat a segment containing only one or more bracketed numeric citation markers as nonlexical with no Organization mentions.
Include an attached geographic qualifier that forms part of the displayed name.
Include a parenthetical initialism in the same mention.
When an Organization name modifies or possesses a product name, record only the Organization component and do not absorb the product into its span.
Treat a country name as an Organization when it denotes its government acting collectively, but not when it denotes only a place.

Use assigned institutional agency, such as membership, signing, refusal, founding, or another deliberate act, as evidence that a country or supranational name denotes its acting government or body; record the literal name now and leave resolution to a more specific national Organization for a later capability.
Treat a supranational name as an Organization when it denotes the acting body, but not when it denotes only a place or jurisdiction of origin.
Exclude a grammatical determiner such as lowercase the unless it conventionally belongs to the displayed Organization name.
Record a later standalone alias as a separate mention occurrence.
